cases.assertion: warning, action, critical and hard thresholds occur in order; backfill throttles first, new archive/backfill stops at critical, consumers drain, and capture safe-stops at hard
each physical filesystem admits the exact reserve boundary and rejects one byte beyond it without borrowing from another filesystem
runtime GC removes only complete transactions before every logical pin; expiry alone never releases a pin and every batch is audited and bounded
an attached paused destination remains a named blocker and no unconsumed event is removed
owner-scheduled RESTART checkpoints report busy/progress and incremental vacuum is page-bounded; automatic full VACUUM is absent
finite source WAL cap risk and unavailable rate metrics are explicit and may require re-seed; no automatic slot drop or fake feedback exists
